With successful installations in 110+ countries, our technologies serve power utilities, railways, oil & gas, airports, defense, and SCADA systems across the globe.

VCL's equipment is successfully deployed in over 6000+ power substations, ranging from 765kV to 33kV, supporting mission-critical operations with unmatched reliability and performance.
